source.note: Built 2026-10-21 from the reformatted Grade 8 Pre-Algebra course (08Prealgebra/02_Design Q3-Q4 Module Formatted folders). Module and item titles, order, sub-headers, points, grading types and Wiris LTI links (quiz id + lookup uuid) were read from the product master copy export (8th-grade-math-pre-algebra-product-master-copy-export.imscc): the course was never deployed to Canvas the old way and has no Module Maps in the formatted set, so the export is the naming authority. Per the reformat decisions of 2026-07-15, the student-facing Prior Knowledge Checks and VR Lesson Resources pages that the export files in its Teacher Resources buckets are published: each Prior Knowledge Check is placed before the lesson it supports (excluded from the final grade, course owner's decision) and each VR page directly after its lesson page. The Lesson 7.02b Prior Knowledge Check and VR page have no lesson in the module (there is no 7.02b lesson page or practice), so they are in the unpublished Teacher Resources module with the Module Lesson Maps; the export's unformatted 'Lesson 10.02a Prior Knowledge' page stays out. Module 8's summatives keep the export's 'v2' titles. Lessons and assignment pages are on https://optimaondemand.github.io/mj-grade-8-pre-algebra. Gradebook groups and weights (40/40/20) from the course owner. The bundled syllabus is a PDF rendered from the course's Syllabus.html template (yellow placeholder fields and the teacher note box included). No week pacing exists in the course files, so no item carries a week.
